pages.text: Sleep Debt first makes you imagine the hunter: its distant silhouette may appear behind you at 570+ debt, briefly standing in the fog until you hold your gaze on it. This apparition is client-side only and cannot hit you.

The REAL Sleepless starts hunting at 830 debt by default, only at night and in the dark. It approaches from behind, leaves isolated footsteps and gathers a dark smoke haze. On hit, darkness lingers and each second attack may briefly blind you. A nearby dreamcatcher prevents natural spawning. After death the hunter gives you temporary grace even if Sleep Debt persists.
